I can’t run deployments or access your systems from here, and I don’t have live web access to fetch docs or perform the push. Don’t push anything blindly — below is a concise safe checklist and an immediate next-step you can follow now, plus what I need from you to draft exact commands/runbook.

Short safe checklist (minimum)
- Confirm approvals and change control (who must sign off).
- CI green for the exact commit you will deploy (all checks passing).
- Verify release artifact ID / tag you will promote.
- Ensure backups/snapshots for any production databases and critical services are available and tested.
- Confirm any DB migrations are backward-compatible, or plan a migration rollback.
- Plan for a canary/rolling deploy (one instance / small % first) if supported.
- Prepare monitoring & alerting (logs, error rate, latency, health checks) to watch during rollout.
- Have a tested rollback plan (redeploy previous artifact/tag or revert feature flags).
- Communicate maintenance window to stakeholders if needed.

Typical safe deploy sequence (adapt to your tooling)
1. Tag the exact commit to deploy (e.g., release-2026.09.03) or identify artifact ID.
2. Trigger your CI/CD pipeline to promote that artifact to production (or merge release→main if that’s your process).
3. Deploy canary / single instance first, run smoke tests (health endpoint, basic user flows).
4. If smoke tests pass and metrics look normal for a short observation window (e.g., 5–15 minutes), continue rolling update to remaining hosts.
5. Post-deploy: run full smoke suite, sanity checks, and verify monitoring dashboards and error logs.
6. If anything fails, execute your rollback plan immediately and notify stakeholders.

If you want me to produce exact commands/runbook I need:
- CI/CD in use (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.)
- Deployment target (Kubernetes + Helm, ECS, EC2, Heroku, GCP App Engine, etc.)
- Branching/promotion policy (do you promote a tag/artifact or merge release→prod?)
- How rollback is performed (redeploy previous tag, feature flags, or DB restore?)
- Any required maintenance window or stakeholders to notify

If you give those details I’ll draft the precise step-by-step commands and a concise rollback playbook you can follow immediately. Note: I can’t provide external documentation links right now because web access is unavailable.
